meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按照迪特·拉姆斯十大设计原则对你的设计进行审计，给每个原则打分并给出证据，然后判断是新建、改进还是重新设计，最后生成一个可直接执行的 /make-plan 提示。
howto.when: 当你要求审计设计、设计评审、检查 UI 是否符合拉姆斯原则、评价 UI 好坏、批评设计或进行设计审计时触发。

say.text: 审计这个页面的设计，按拉姆斯原则打分。
say.note: Claude 会启动审计流程，收集证据并生成评分卡。

say.text: 检查这个 UI 是否符合拉姆斯原则，并给出改进计划。
say.note: Claude 会输出审计结果和 /make-plan 提示。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude audits a design against Dieter Rams' ten principles, scores each with evidence, decides NEW/REFINE/REDESIGN, and hands off a /make-plan prompt.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to audit a design, design review, check UI against Rams, critique, or request a design audit that should lead to a plan.

say_en.text: Audit this page design against Rams' principles.
say_en.note: Claude starts the audit process, gathers evidence, and produces a scorecard.

say_en.text: Check this UI against Rams and give a refinement plan.
say_en.note: Claude outputs audit results and a /make-plan prompt.
